monthly.note: 本月(2026 年 10 月)及最近期(近 30-60 天)內,符合嚴謹「已正式發佈(GA)」標準的遊戲模組 Rigging 工具新發佈或重大更新不足 5 個。因此僅列出符合條件的 2 個項目。
monthly.note_en: Less than 5 new or significantly updated game module rigging tools meeting the strict 'General Availability (GA)' criteria were released this month (October 2026) and recently (last 30-60 days). Therefore, only 2 qualifying items are listed.

items.name: Bake3D
items.why: 全新 AI 驅動的 3D 生成、綁骨和動畫平台正式發佈,能將靜態圖像轉化為可生產的 3D 資產,並支援多種非人形角色綁骨。
items.why_en: Newly launched AI-powered 3D generation, rigging, and animation platform that converts still images into production-ready 3D assets, supporting rigging for a wide range of non-humanoid characters.

items.name: Meshy
items.version: Meshy 7 模型更新 (Meshy 7 Model Update)
items.why: Meshy 7 模型更新帶來更精細的幾何形狀、更清晰的硬表面細節,並新增語義分割功能,顯著提升自動綁骨前置模型的品質與效率。
items.why_en: Meshy 7 model update brings refined geometry, sharper hard-surface details, and new Semantic Segmentation, significantly improving the quality and efficiency of models for auto-rigging.
